text:
maya: FYI rolling out the streaming mode switch to `fast-path` caused a spike in reconnects for a subset of EU tenants ~10m after rollout. Console shows reconnects -> duplicate token billing. Anyone seen this pattern before? :grimacing:

oliver: saw alerts too. can you paste the alert id / link?

maya: alert id `ALRT-3259` -> https://console.redwood/api/alerts/ALRT-3259  
metrics: `reconnect.count` up x4 on route eu-west-2, `billing.duplicate_tokens` up x2. logs attached:  
```
# sample from proxy
2026-03-23T10:11:12Z INFO reconnect set cookie=sticky-42 route=eu-west-2 -> eu-west-1
2026-03-23T10:11:12Z WARN resume-failed id=abc123 reason=stale-session
2026-03-23T10:11:13Z INFO request proxied id=abc123 tokens=54 billed=true
```

jess: hm looks like a route-swap happened during the switch. clients resumed against a different shard so prefix KV miss -> full regen and billed tokens twice. sampling in the console UI is hiding the jump because `reconnect.sample_frac` is 0.01 for cost metrics.

ande: that sampling explains the console blindspot. if we're under-sampling we won't see per-route spikes until they blow up. propose: temporarily bump `reconnect.sample_frac` to 0.1 for 30m for eu-west routes and add a dashboard tile for per-route duplicate token rate.

oliver: agree to bump sampling for diagnostics but we need an escape hatch if dashboard query costs blow up. can we do a short-lived config flag scoped to the rollout?

maya: yeah plan: 1) flip `reconnect.sample_frac` for eu-west to 0.1 (30m) 2) sticky routing heuristic: prefer previous shard for 30s after mode switch (soft fallback) 3) add `billing.duplicate_tokens` per-route chart to the deploy rollout dashboard  

jess: small note: sticky for 30s avoids most double-regens but may increase tail latency for a few clients if their old shard is overloaded. tradeoff acceptable for healthcheck window.

oliver: also flagging that the resume idempotency path should be hardened — maybe add a cheap de-dupe check in the billing pipeline keyed by `resume_id` + `request_hash` to prevent double billing when we detect quick double-resume. low-risk guard.

maya: good call. add to follow-up RFC. For now I'll enact the sampling bump + sticky policy. tagging @andre to run the dashboard query and keep an eye on query cost.

andre: on it. running query now, will post results in ~5m. :eyes:  

sre-bot: [automated] Alert `ALRT-3259` acknowledged by maya. Post-mortem ticket created: PMT-7812.

jess: quick asks for console UX team: can we make the per-route sampling slider more discoverable during rollouts? it's buried in advanced settings and causes this exact confusion. small UX win.

maya: agreed — will loop in @product-console. for now action items:
- maya: bump sample_frac (eu-west) -> 0.1 for 30m (doing now)
- andre: surface per-route `duplicate_tokens` chart and watch query cost
- oliver: draft cheap billing de-dupe guard RFC
- jess: add note about sticky-window tradeoffs to rollout runbook

oliver: thanks all. if numbers don't drop in 15m we rollback `fast-path` on the eu-west canary.

andre: query results: per-route duplicate_tokens peaked at T+8m on canary, correlates with route swaps. CPU on original shard rose ~15%. pushing dashboard now.

maya: sampling bump done. will update in 10m. :thumbsup:
